Home / Qualification

The Certified Chartered Tax Advisor (CCTA) qualification

Advanced competence in taxation, regulatory compliance and ethical professional conduct. Open to anyone who wants a career in taxation.

Designed for SLQF Level 6On-demand computer based examsStudy at your own pace

PATHWAY

From Foundation to Graduate Diploma

01. Entry Route

Awareness Level

Certified Tax Associate

Equal to SLQF Level 3 / NVQ Level 5

02

Technical Level

Certified Tax Accountant

Equal to SLQF Level 4 / NVQ Level 6

03

Application Level

Certified Tax Analyst

Equal to SLQF Level 6

04

Advisory Level

Certified Chartered Tax Advisor

Equal to SLQF Level 9

Completing all levels and gaining three years of experience leads to Associate Membership (ACTA).

COMPETENCY FRAMEWORK

What you will learn

Every paper maps to the ACCTA taxation competency framework.

Direct tax

Individual income taxPartnership taxCorporate taxBanking and financeTrustsWithholding tax

Indirect tax

VATSSCLStamp duty

Other taxes

Customs dutyPALExcise dutyTelecommunication levyVehicle taxTDL

Professional and cross-cutting modules

International taxationTransfer pricingTax administrationCase law applicationDigital taxationTax psychology and behavioural economicsTax forensicsAccounting and financeBusiness strategyLegal principlesGovernance and ethics

The Governance and Ethics module follows the UK tax advisers' framework. Affiliate members who pass this paper become eligible for Associate membership.

EXAMINATIONS

Book an exam when you are ready

Exams are computer-based and available on demand throughout the year. Exam centres and online proctoring details will be confirmed.

EXEMPTIONS

Recognition of prior learning

Holders of recognised professional and academic qualifications may apply for exemptions.
